title: Technical Architecture
description: Explains major architectural components, infrastructure layers, and component relationships.
purpose: Provide engineering and technical leadership with a clear structural architectural blueprint.

include_when: The solution involves multiple technical components, microservices, or cloud infrastructure.
System integration, model endpoints, or tiered storage are involved.
exclude_when: Simple process-only or operational workflow POCs with negligible technical architecture.

instructions: Detail each architectural component, its layer, and its single responsibility.
Do not invent speculative infrastructure or unapproved services.

content_structure.purpose: Overview of the technical architecture and core patterns.
Visual representation of component hierarchy and boundaries.
Tabular breakdown of components and responsibilities.

title: Technology Stack & Rationale
description: Lists the selected technologies, frameworks, and tools alongside justification for each choice.
purpose: Justify technology choices and prove fitness for purpose.

include_when: Specific languages, frameworks, cloud services, or AI models are proposed.
exclude_when: Technology selection is fully predetermined by existing client standards and needs no evaluation.

instructions: Present proposed technologies in a structured table.
Provide solid engineering rationale for each choice.

title: Data Flow & Processing Lifecycle
description: Traces the path and transformations of data as it passes through ingestion, processing, and output.
purpose: Clarify lifecycle, persistence, state transitions, and formats of data.

include_when: Data transformations, pipelines, ingestion, or ETL/ELT flows are central to the POC.
exclude_when: Projects with simple static UI/CRUD and trivial single-database queries.

instructions: Trace data from source ingress through parsing, indexing/transformation, to query or output.
Specify protocols and storage mechanics wherever grounded in context.

content_structure.purpose: Ordered sequence of data processing stages.

title: Security, Privacy & Compliance
description: Details authentication, access controls, data encryption, and privacy safeguards relevant to the POC.
purpose: Ensure security and compliance risks are acknowledged and appropriately bounded.

include_when: Sensitive client data, personally identifiable information (PII), or external APIs are used.
Cloud hosting, auth identity, or compliance boundaries must be articulated.
exclude_when: Local isolated sandbox POCs with mock public data and no credential dependencies.

instructions: Address data in transit and at rest encryption.
Specify tenant isolation and IAM identity boundaries.
Highlight unresolved client compliance questions as explicit items.

content_structure.purpose: Table comparing POC safeguards with eventual production requirements.

title: Risks, Assumptions & Dependencies
description: Identifies technical, operational, and prerequisite dependencies alongside mitigation strategies.
purpose: De-risk delivery and record dependencies on client resources or external APIs.

include_when: Material technical risks, third-party API dependencies, or client provisioning prerequisites exist.

instructions: Identify specific risks and their operational impact.
Provide concrete mitigations for each risk.
Explicitly list all required client-provided access and sample datasets.

title: Indicative Delivery Timeline
description: Outlines delivery phases, sprint milestones, and sequential execution blocks.
purpose: Provide a time horizon and staging for the POC execution.

include_when: Project has stated duration, sprints, or multi-stage delivery milestones.
exclude_when: Timeframe is entirely unknown or deliberately omitted at the proposal stage.

instructions: Organize the timeline into clear chronological phases.
State inputs and key outputs for each milestone.
Do not invent fixed calendar dates unless supplied in context.
